description: A young man with dark wavy hair, a white shirt, dark vest and stained canvas apron leans over a wooden table in a stone-vaulted kitchen, cutting into a dark chocolate cake on a metal pedestal stand with a knife. A glass jar of apricot jam with a spoon sits on the table beside him. A fireplace with flames glows on the left, copper pots hang on the walls, and a woman in a white cap and apron works in the background.
